title: RAW same hidden condition stirs: one relational qo schema over health and pain
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_PARTIAL_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. The complete Laufenberg Spring unit motivates preservation of a pre-existing hidden condition and its human owner while it stirs at the season. Two newly guessed kind atoms dar/daiin and exact qodar/qodaiin licenses share a compound relational schema; no target owner, condition identity or time is bound. A new episode of an existing condition remains a serious compatible rival.

design.mechanism: A kind-parametric relation preserves the identity, kind and human owner of a condition already hidden in that person, and asserts its stirring at a later named time. It does not negate a property, create that condition, diagnose it, or administer treatment.
design.unit: Complete owned f85r2 N.2-6, E.7-11, S.12-17, W.18-23 plus both outside loci .1/.24, each literal reader separate; local derivations are seeds only. Source obligation is the complete Spring body40 verses plus its separate2-verse caption, not just164.P12-17.
design.contrast: Same condition instance stirring versus a newly occurring episode of an existing condition; detection is a second relation with no automatic stirring entailment. Source compatibility alone does not choose these ontologies.
design.prediction: If complete written owner/instance/time bindings are later supplied, both exact qo compounds must preserve the same kind and pre-existing owner-instance pair under one relation. The repeated qodaiin cannot switch to creation, detection, treatment or a different condition-kind by occurrence. Current target discrimination capacity is zero.

not_source_entailed: Hidden is not equivalent to previously inactive. No NOT_STIRRING precondition is imposed.
No outward visibility, diagnostic seeing, observer or successful recognition is asserted.
No numeric intensity increase is extracted from the uncertain sunder me phrase.
No resurrection of a dead patient follows from the preceding earthly-revival metaphor.
Two explicit ordered times and a persistent reified condition instance are model choices, not separately decoded source tokens.
The health/pain alternative is not proof that both occur in every person or that the two kinds exhaust all medical conditions.
The narrator is not automatically the pictured Spring figure or a physician. Caption and main instruction remain distinct.

typed_contract.Person: A human owner, not the season, narrator, organ or physician by default; no target terminal assigned.
typed_contract.ConditionInstance: A persistent reified condition of a person; distinct from its kind and from an episode. Reification/identity is an explicit additional model assumption.
typed_contract.Time: Two explicitly owned ordered reference times; no calendar dates, duration or units assigned.

daiin.meaning: PAIN_ILLNESS; retains the source's pain/illness translation breadth rather than selecting a modern diagnosis

qo.type: ConditionKind -> (Person x ConditionInstance x Time x Time -> Proposition)
qo.name: PREEXISTING_HIDDEN_CONDITION_STIRS
qo.law: Q(k)(p,c,t0,t1) iff t0<t1 AND Exists(c,t0) AND Kind(c,t0)=k AND HiddenIn(c,p,t0) AND Exists(c,t1) AND Kind(c,t1)=k AND Owner(c,t1)=p AND StirsIn(c,p,t1).
qo.status: Compound relational schema, not a cheap atomic one-place operation or a physical action performed by reading/writing the word.
qo.not_implied: No NOT_STIRRING at t0, no NOT_HIDDEN at t1, no observer/knowledge update, no new condition identifier, no universal human activation, no recommendation or clinical success.
qo.season_requirement: The complete target reading must separately bind t1 to the relevant season/time. Q contains no invisible Spring constant.

typed_contract.writer_limit: Exactly two compounds; no standalone qo token, no d/ar/aiin analysis, no qodain alias, no other qo word receives this rule.
typed_contract.application_grammar: UNBOUND. Each derived relation requires ordered written arguments p,c,t0,t1, directly or through a fixed explicit binder. No nearest-name or paragraph-owner default. A bare kind is not itself a hidden condition or an assertion.

actual_two_inputs_and_reuse.meaning: Same hidden HEALTH condition, same human owner, stirring at bound t1; health is not changed into illness.

rivals.name: NEW_EPISODE_OF_EXISTING_CONDITION
rivals.contract: Keep the same kind, pre-existing hidden condition c and owner p. At t1 a distinct episode z of c begins/stirs; c is not a newly created disease. The written post-event reference may denote z rather than c.
rivals.source_limit: This can be compatible with the source. The vernacular does not by itself fix the reified condition-versus-episode ontology.
rivals.distinction_if_bound: A complete later assertion explicitly about the same c versus the new episode z would differ. No such target assertion is currently bound.

rivals.name: DETECTION_OF_EXISTING_CONDITION
rivals.contract: An existing hidden condition is recognized/reported at t1. Detection does not entail StirsIn and stirring does not entail detection. Any observer and report scope must be written; identifying observer with patient is an additional assumption.
rivals.source_limit: Detection could accompany stirring, so source compatibility alone does not refute it. It fails to own the source's stirring claim only if no other complete written clause does so.

rivals.name: DE_NOVO_CONDITION_CREATION_CONTROL
rivals.contract: The same claimed condition c first exists at t1, having not existed before.
rivals.limit: This conflicts with the main pre-existence contract if c and times are genuinely the same. It is an easy negative control, not the strongest rival and not an observed target contradiction.

design.different_consequence_from537_554: For a fixed written p,c,t0,t1, the main relation entails pre-existence, stable kind/owner and stirring of c at t1. NOT/HAS or PREDOMINATES at one state entails none of that history or identity. Merely negating a condition is not an alternative implementation of Q. Conversely Q does not entail the absence of health/pain, a corrective prescription, or a new latent state becoming visible.
design.falsifier: After a complete explicit writing contract is frozen, reject this exact schema if one licensed compound needs creation/detection/correction while the other needs stirring, a required written post-reference changes c or owner without its declared relation, a compulsory prior absence contradicts pre-existence of that same c, or a bare kind must serve as a proposition. Unknown arguments and source-compatible rival ontologies now mean INCOMPLETE, not rejection.
